items.line: **`EncodeArtworkID(artID) string`** in [`core/artwork/artwork.go`](/core/artwork/artwork.go) signs a public token with one string claim, `id`. It replaces `PublicLink`, which is removed.
items.requirement: EncodeArtworkID must transform a model.ArtworkID into a public token string that encodes only the artwork's id value (as a string id claim) and does not include image size information.

items.line: **Given** the artwork `model.NewArtworkID(model.KindArtistArtwork, "1234")`, **When** it is encoded with `EncodeArtworkID` and the result is decoded with `DecodeArtworkID`, **Then** the same artwork id comes back with no error.
items.requirement: EncodeArtworkID followed by DecodeArtworkID must round-trip for a valid artwork id (e.g. model.NewArtworkID(model.KindArtistArtwork, "1234")), returning the same model.ArtworkID with no error.

items.line: **`DecodeArtworkID(token) (ArtworkID, error)`** in the same file verifies the token and requires a string `id` claim. ... Each failure has its own message: "invalid JWT" for an unverifiable token, and "invalid artwork id" for an unparseable id. A missing or non-string `id` fails too.
items.requirement: DecodeArtworkID must decode a provided token string, require an id claim, verify that the claim is a string, parse it into a model.ArtworkID, and return an error when the token is invalid, unauthorized, missing the required claim, has an invalid ID type, or contains an invalid artwork ID.

items.line: **Given** the string `"xx-123"`, **When** it is decoded, **Then** the error matches "invalid JWT".
items.requirement: DecodeArtworkID must return an error satisfying MatchError("invalid JWT") for structurally invalid or unverifiable token strings (e.g. the input "xx-123").

items.line: **Given** the token of an encoded empty `model.ArtworkID{}`, **When** it is decoded, **Then** the error matches "invalid artwork id".
items.requirement: DecodeArtworkID must return an error satisfying MatchError("invalid artwork id") when the id claim is a valid string but cannot be parsed into a valid artwork id (e.g. the token produced by encoding an empty model.ArtworkID{}).

items.line: **Given** a validly signed public token with no `id` claim, **When** it is decoded, **Then** an error is returned.
items.requirement: DecodeArtworkID must return a non-nil error when given a valid public token that contains no id claim.

items.line: **Resizing** in [`reader_resized.go`](/core/artwork/reader_resized.go) is unchanged: it already keeps the source format. A new test covers a PNG at 15.
items.requirement: Artwork resizing must preserve the source image format when resizing; a PNG source must continue to be returned as a PNG after resizing.

items.line: **SC-004** (PNG): A PNG resized to 15 is a PNG of 15 by 15 pixels.
items.requirement: When resizing a PNG source to a requested size of 15, the returned image must be a PNG decoding to bounds of 15 x 15 pixels.
